I can't tell you, but I'll give you a clue: [random name of the Power Moon] ♪ It's hiding somewhere and no peeking! ♪ Go find it, go find it, scra-CAW!|Talkatoo|''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''}} '''Talkatoo''' is a character in ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. It is a yellow parrot wearing a brown explorer's hat. It appears in each major kingdom (i.e. excluding kingdoms that do not contain [[regional coin]]s). However, in some kingdoms it only appears after a certain event: in the [[Cap Kingdom]] upon returning there after powering up the [[Odyssey]] in the [[Cascade Kingdom]], in the Cascade Kingdom after collecting the "[[Multi Moon Atop the Falls]]" [[Multi Moon]], in the [[Metro Kingdom]] after collecting the "[[New Donk City's Pest Problem]]" Multi Moon, in [[Bowser's Kingdom]] after collecting the "[[Showdown at Bowser's Castle]]" Multi Moon, and in the [[Moon Kingdom]] after completing the "[[Bowser's Moon Wedding]]" story mission. Talkatoo gives the player the names of uncollected [[Power Moon]]s when consulted. This adds the name of the Power Moon to the Power Moon List, and it marks that row with a Talkatoo icon. Talkatoo can provide only three such clues at a time for each kingdom; talking to Talkatoo again while this limit is met means Talkatoo repeats a name it has already provided. Obtaining the Power Moon removes Talkatoo's icon from the entry in the Power Moon List and frees up another slot for a hint. Once [[Mario]] has collected every Power Moon in a kingdom, Talkatoo does not provide any more hints for that kingdom. During the fight against [[Mollusque-Lanceur]], Talkatoo only squawks in fear and does not provide hints when prompted. ==Gallery== SMOTalkatooModel.png|Model SMO Asset Sprite MP Talkatoo.png|Map / dialogue sprite Talkatoo SMO.jpg|Screenshot of Talkatoo in the [[Cascade Kingdom]] Talkatoo.JPG|Screenshot of Talkatoo in the Cascade Kingdom SMO Snapshot Talkatoo.jpg|Screenshot of Talkatoo at the [[Sand Kingdom]] Talkatoo SMO New Donk City screenshot.jpg|Screenshot of Talkatoo in the [[Metro Kingdom]] ==Quotes== *"''Scary, scary!
